class.name: MaszynaTrianglesChunkGeometry
class.brief_description: The triangles of one terrain chunk.
class.description: Scenery [code]triangles[/code] nodes sharing a texture, a cell of the 1 km grid and a visibility range ([SceneryTrianglesSink]), a file of its own read only while the camera is within the chunk's range. Positions are relative to the cell's centre, stored as floats.

method.name: split
method.description: The chunk as pieces of at most [constant MAX_VERTICES], cut between whole triangles - itself when it is no larger.

method.name: to_mesh_arrays
method.description: [constant Mesh.ARRAY_MAX] arrays with the vertices, normals and UVs, for [method ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays].

members.member: Visible up to this distance, 0 or less - no limit of its own.
x, y, z per vertex, relative to the cell's centre.

constants.constant: The most vertices a chunk is built of. A chunk is uploaded on the main thread in one go, and one build is never cut by [SceneryStreamingServer]'s frame budget - a dense section of a region file is ~700 000 vertices.
